diagnosis.summary: In the 885x501 offset viewport the temporal receiver guard (1/width, 1/height) widened the fitted frustum before 1/16 radius quantization only when temporal accumulation was on, so cascades 0, 1 and 3 used larger texels (+0.752%, +0.389%, +0.106%). The one-texel MASK grille's shadow falls in cascade 1 and aliased differently: solid with temporal on, faintly hatched with it off.

region.definition: regions.region: the grille card's outline carried along the sun to the ground and projected at the final pan pose (0072 cascade_texels.py math, reproduced exactly), grown 4 px, minus the card quad and the analytic sphere each grown 3 px, clipped to the viewport

metrics.space: linear-light luminance (0..1) decoded from the 8-bit sRGB PNGs

bars.definition: grille-bar pixels inside the projected card quad: G >= 60 and G >= 1.3 max(R, B). The card's visible face is not sun-lit (N.L = -0.394), so bar classification does not depend on the shadow fit.

thresholds.rule: calibration.derived: each limit is the geometric mean of the worst consistent-fit control and the best mismatch control, rounded down to two significant figures; selfcheck.py recomputes the controls and refuses any other value
